title: JuneCreate
description: just another create modpack? no... just MY create modpack!!
body:
~~It's another create modpack!~~
It's _MY_ create modpack!!

Built for nerds! Centered around Computer Craft and Create, with a few custom recipes to make everything flow a lil' nicer! (not yet implemented)

Currently waiting on KubeJS: Create to update to 1.21.1 neoforge, and for Create: Estrogen to update to support version 6.x.x of Create.

(expect updates)
